create_ReservoirBuffer: create a ReservoirBuffer with a given capacity to enable uniform sampling from a data stream
add_element_buffer: add elements to a ReservoirBuffer using reservoir sampling to maintain uniform probability
sample_from_buffer: sample a specified number of uniformly random elements from a ReservoirBuffer
clear_ReservoirBuffer: clear all elements and reset the add counter of a ReservoirBuffer
iterate_ReservoirBuffer: iterate over elements in a ReservoirBuffer using standard Python iteration
